 Search reasoning chains, or fetch them for one claim with --claim-id.

 Query: POST /reasoning/search. Claim: GET /claims/{id}/reasoning.

 Examples:
 gaia search lkm reasoning "solid state battery dendrite suppression"
 gaia search lkm reasoning --claim-id <gcn_id>
 What you have:
 a topic or claim text   ->  reasoning <query>
 a claim id (gcn_...)    ->  reasoning --claim-id
 a question id           ->  knowledge, not --claim-id
 a paper id from a hit   ->  package
 Use query mode as a search surface for reasoning chains and workflows. It is
 parallel to `knowledge <query>`, which searches paper knowledge items such as
 conclusions, weak points, highlights, problems, and open questions.
 Use --claim-id only when you already have a claim id and want that claim's
 supporting reasoning graph.
 Query mode accepts search filters (--paper-id, --doi, --title, publication
 dates, --sort-by). --claim-id mode fetches one claim's backing chains and only
 accepts --max-chains plus --sort-by comprehensive|recent.
